findings.text: red-team lens, high: `stage.start` is now emitted for every cycle-member dispatch on every run (fresh and resume alike), because `_cd_iter` is always ≥ 1 and the guard has no `_ZBUILD_RESUME_ACTIVE` check; the design decision explicitly flagged this as Gap 7 / NOT YET FIXED and required the guard `if [[ ${_ZBUILD_RESUME_ACTIVE:-false} == true ]] && [[ "$_cd_iter" -gt 0 ]]`. (core/pipeline/runner.sh:3204; fix: code)

red-team lens, medium: `_runner_resume_rehydrate` returns 0 (success) when `_artifact_persist_restore` fails, so stale on-disk artifacts from a prior run that pre-exist in `$_rr_artifacts_dir` are silently accepted as the restored artifacts; `_artifact_persist_put_back` is no-clobber, so pre-existing files are never overwritten, violating RHYD-1's byte-identical guarantee without any error or event. (core/pipeline/runner.sh:1712; fix: code)
